name: finglish-to-persian
description: Finglish → فارسی: type Persian with a Latin keyboard. An offline transliteration engine, a website to try it and a macOS keyboard.
author: Mehras Hojjat (https://mehrashojjat.com)

scripts.e2e: cd tests/e2e && npm install --silent && node smoke.js && node site.js
scripts.proof:offline: node tests/audit_offline.js && node tests/no_network_selftest.js && NODE_OPTIONS='--require ./tests/no_network_preload.js' node --test tests/engine.test.js && cd tests/e2e && node offline_proof.js
scripts.proof:mac: npm run parity && mkdir -p build && swiftc -swift-version 5 -O tests/swift_host/main.swift -o build/farsi-host-check && build/farsi-host-check engine/dist tests/golden/parity_vectors.jsonl && cd tests/e2e && node parity_browser.js
scripts.proof: npm run proof:offline && npm run proof:mac
